observations.behavior: Clarification of model-name parsing rules: bare nicknames are families, not versions; no-version names resolve to highest-numbered entry; version comparisons use decimals.
observations.code_quote: A question or a data request about a model — its cost, speed, token use, error rate, or how it compares with other models — is subject matter. This stays true when the model name comes after "for", "via", "on", or "with". To change the run, the message must also tell you to run this task on that model.
observations.posthog_connection: These rules guide the Slack App's AI activity classifier, which decides whether a user message requests a model switch or merely discusses models. Correct classification prevents false-positive model switches and ensures the agent executes the intended task.
